newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index edges up in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index edges up in moderate trade.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index edged up in a moderate trading session, bourse officials said.
The index gained 7.80 points to close at 3466.18. Turnover was posted at 20.8 million points traded on 775,289 shares compared to 23.6 million shillings traded on 544,283 shares on Tuesday.
Uchumi Supermarket edged up a shilling to close at 38.50 while Nation Printers & Publishers was unchanged at 120.
Barclays Bank closed at 110, unchanged, while Standard Chartered Bank eased to 48 from 50. National Bank of Kenya traded at 16 from 16.05.
Kenya National Mills closed a shilling up at 38.25 while Kenya Power & Lighting was unchanged at 175.
Kakuzi closed at 106, unchanged, while Sasini Tea & Coffee eased at 79 from 80.
